[[Image:Aile Dashar map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
'''Aile Dashar''' is an archipelago that is controlled by the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' and [[Amayar]]. The islands are located northwest of [[Arad Doman]].
